title: FlowEdit: Associative Memory for Lifelong Pronunciation Adaptation in Flow-Matching TTS
title_zh: FlowEdit：面向 Flow-Matching TTS 终身发音自适应的关联记忆方法
abstract_en: Flow-matching text-to-speech systems achieve remarkable zero-shot quality but remain static after deployment: pronunciation errors on out-of-vocabulary proper nouns persist unless the model is retrained. We introduce FlowEdit, a life-long adaptation framework for frozen flow-matching TTS that learns pronunciation corrections as latent conditioning edits rather than weight updates. When corrective feedback is provided, FlowEdit optimizes a token-level perturbation in the text embedding space, then stores the correction in a Modern Hopfield Network serving as content-addressable episodic memory. At inference, corrections are retrieved via soft attention with a similarity gate, enabling fuzzy morphological matching. On our curated benchmark of 312 multilingual proper nouns across 18 language families, FlowEdit reduces target-word Phoneme Error Rate by 92.7% relative to the zero-shot baseline while maintaining identical general-speech quality. Corrections complete in approximately 15 seconds on a single GPU.
abstract_zh: Flow-matching text-to-speech 系统具备很强的 zero-shot 语音合成质量，但部署后通常是静态的：对于未登录专有名词（out-of-vocabulary proper nouns）的发音错误，若不重新训练模型就会持续存在。本文提出 FlowEdit，一种用于冻结 flow-matching TTS 的终身自适应框架。它不更新模型权重，而是将发音纠正学习为潜在条件编辑（latent conditioning edits）。当用户提供纠错反馈时，FlowEdit 在文本嵌入空间中优化 token 级扰动，并将该纠正存入作为内容可寻址情景记忆的 Modern Hopfield Network。推理时，系统通过带相似度门控的 soft attention 检索相关纠正，从而支持模糊的形态匹配。在包含 18 个语系、312 个多语言专有名词的自建基准上，FlowEdit 相比 zero-shot 基线将目标词 Phoneme Error Rate 降低 92.7%，同时保持通用语音质量不变。单个 GPU 上每次纠正约 15 秒完成。
key_points_zh: 提出 FlowEdit，用于冻结的 flow-matching TTS，实现无需重训权重的终身发音自适应。
将用户纠错转化为文本嵌入空间中的 token 级潜在扰动，并存入 Modern Hopfield Network 作为关联式情景记忆。
推理阶段通过 soft attention 与相似度门控检索纠正，可对形态相近的专有名词进行模糊匹配。
在 312 个跨 18 个语系的多语言专有名词基准上，目标词 Phoneme Error Rate 相对 zero-shot 基线下降 92.7%。
纠正过程约 15 秒即可在单 GPU 上完成，并保持通用语音合成质量不变。

llm_assessment.comment: FlowEdit is a technically interesting lifelong memory mechanism for TTS correction, but it is largely outside agent harness evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: FlowEdit是面向TTS纠错的有趣终身记忆机制，但基本不属于智能体运行框架演进方向。
